title: Big black triangle hovers over Vandenberg runway

When I arrived on scene, I talked to five shaken witnesses who described a massive triangular craft larger than a football field that hovered silently for about 45 seconds over their entry control point before shooting away at impossible speed.
tellings.difference: Told first-hand, dated October 14, 2003, hovering about 45 seconds over the entry control point (not the runway) with five witnesses, then leaving at great speed.
tellings.link_reason: Nuccetelli's large triangle hovering over Vandenberg is the big black triangle story that Matthew Brown relays from him.

as_told.title: Football-field-sized triangle over entry control point at Vandenberg

plain: A huge black triangle is said to have come in from the Pacific Ocean and hovered over Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. Jeff Natelli tells it first hand: he says he went to the scene on October 14, 2003, and "talked to five shaken witnesses." They described "a massive triangular craft larger than a football field" that hovered without a sound for about 45 seconds over their entry gate, then "shooting away at impossible speed." Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official, repeats the story from Natelli, saying the triangle came "out of the Pacific Ocean flying into Vandenberg." If true, a large unknown craft sat in plain view over a military base.
